explanation: I found no match in Mathlib. The theorem is the equality case of the Schwarz–Pick lemma: if a holomorphic self-map of the disc keeps the hyperbolic distance between two distinct points, it is a disc automorphism. It is stated with library definitions (`PoincareDisc`, `hyperbolicDist`, `unitDiscStandardAutomorphismIsometryEquiv`). The proof is a transport of the library's own lemma `exists_forall_unitDisc_eq_unitDiscStandardAutomorphismEquiv_of_hyperbolicDist_map_eq`. I searched Mathlib's `Analysis/Complex` folder for "Poincare", "hyperbolicDist", "SchwarzPick"/"schwarz_pick" and "automorphism" and read the declarations in `Mathlib/Analysis/Complex/Schwarz.lean`. That file has only Schwarz-lemma inequalities and an affine rigidity result on balls. There is no Schwarz–Pick lemma, no hyperbolic metric on the disc, and no classification of disc automorphisms.
